content.short: Walapay provides stablecoin-powered API infrastructure for moving and managing money globally.
content.description: Walapay gives platforms an API for creating virtual bank accounts and digital asset wallets on behalf of their customers. Integration runs in stages: customer compliance covering terms acceptance and KYC or KYB checks, then account creation, then fiat-to-fiat payments. The documentation publishes supported activities alongside the full API specification. It operates on Monad among other networks.
content.meta: Stablecoin rails for global money movement, kept invisible to the end customer.
